segments.text: I don't believe that you could become an AI first organization talking about AI and delivering AI >> [music] >> unless you've been through that journey and understand what that looks like.

For me, becoming frontier firm is a is a state of mind and it's the way that we think about challenges and reinvent processes. We knew we had a challenge with lots of disparate systems cuz and we knew to embrace AI we needed to consolidate all of that data into one place so that we could unlock all of the the value that was there.
The customer zero journey has touched every element of our organization and it enables the departments now to become change agents. It's giving tons of capacity back into my team.

Um we've automated a number of workflows including supplier invoicing. It's enabled the team to focus on more important anonymization and strategic initiatives. That's allowed us to grow by 40% over the last year with the same head count that we had 2 years ago uh and operational savings of 1 and 1/2.

So for Infinity Group the business impact has been truly transformational. We've gone from local IT provider to global business central partner of the year in the space of 3 years. Because it allows us to talk with authenticity to our clients about the technology we're using and how we're using it within our organization.

It's had a huge impact on our culture. It's really delivering value for us allowing our people to do more important work. I think probably the biggest success that we've had is the opportunity for new people to come into the business and not feel left behind because ideally we've spent quite a bit of time um prepping ourselves,

practicing with AI. >> [music] >> And so everybody's learning, everybody's talking about it and there's a general passion and interest. Partners, if I was to give you three bits of advice, it would be this.
Number one, understand your business challenges, talk to your teams, >> [music] >> find the bottlenecks. Number two, get your data sorted out. Cannot underestimate how important that is.

And number three, take your people on the journey. They may feel threatened, but you want to make them feel empowered. You know, we're moving into a world where AI is just transforming the way that we work and the way that we deliver services.
If you really want to transform your clients, you need to start by transforming yourself first.
